evidence: Adds a GitHub Actions workflow and helper scripts to run Guix builds (.github/workflows/guix.yml, .github/install-guix.sh, contrib/guix/libexec/prelude.bash).
rationale: Running Guix builds in CI catches build breakages, missing imports, and codesign manifest errors before changes merge rather than late during the release cycle. Reviewers emphasize that compiling in a release context catches issues currently missed.
